With June's approval, I saved the draft mail to Tobias Rendle (trendle@pemberline.com) with the subject "Tansley 2027 rate". It gives the proposed 2027 Tansley Parcel rate of $1,313 per seat and is signed from Pree. Nothing was sent; it's only a draft. I replied to June in our direct messages to confirm.

- **Whose mailbox:** Pree asked for the draft in her own mailbox, but the drafting tool saves to mine (assistant@pemberline.com). It's there, not in Pree's. I didn't mention this to June, so Pree or June may need to know so someone can send it.
- **Ilse Varga's request:** I took June's approval to cover Pree's draft only, because of "as Pree gave it". Ilse separately asked for a draft from her to Tobias with the same rate. I asked June whether her approval covers that one too and haven't drafted anything for Ilse yet.
- **Account owner:** I couldn't confirm Pree owns Tansley Parcel because I can't see any Tansley account files. This didn't block the draft, since June approved sharing the figure with Tobias.
